review:
Aiko and the Wind Spirit is a gentle-looking Japanese fantasy slot with a sharper engine underneath. Spirit symbols that join a win turn into expanding wilds covering every position above them, each with a 2x to 100x multiplier for its reel, and several spirits in the same win add their values together.

Zephyr Crest symbols keep things going: landing one with an expanded spirit triggers a respin, nudges every spirit one reel to the left and gives each a fresh multiplier. A spirit can keep travelling across the grid until it falls off the left edge. Three free spins rounds build on this, and the maximum is 10,000x.
